notes.title: Rynna is coming back in "Shalnor: Silverwind Saga"
notes.notes:
Greeeetings,
I know many of you have been waiting for a long time to play as Rynna again.
Good News!

Rynna will return in the upcoming game "Shalnor: Silverwind Saga"
This game is similar to [b]Sacred Lands[/b] in many ways, but at the same time it focuses a lot more on combat.

If you liked the first game, then definitely [b]WISHLIST[/b] Silverwind Saga.
Also, a demo for the game will be released soon :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2907050/Shalnor_Silverwind_Saga

notes.title: SHALNOR LEGENDS 2 - RELEASED!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

After 5 years in development, Shalnor Legends 2 Is finally here.
I hope you enjoy playing this game as much as I enjoyed making it :)

[i]A Story-Rich RPG/Action-Adventure game. Step into the shoes of the young Orc Mogren and explore all of Thunder Island. Venture into dangerous dungeons, explore caves, solve puzzles, and help the residents of the island with their quests.[/i]

Link to the game below, if you know anyone who would also be interested in this game, feel free to forward the link to them:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221170

notes.title: SHALNOR LEGENDS 2 IS COMING!
notes.notes:
I know I have been keeping you waiting for half a decade now, but I assure you it was worth it.

The sequel will be coming out in 2023, and it is my most ambitious project so far.

[i]Shalnor Legends 2: Trials of Thunder is a Story-Rich RPG/Action-Adventure Game, made by one person over the course of four years. Step into the shoes of the young Orc Mogren, and explore all of Thunder Island. Venture into dangerous dungeons, explore caves and solve puzzles and help the residents of the island with their quests.[/i]

Please [b]WISHLIST[/b] it, and if you know anyone who would also be interested in this kind of game, feel free to forward the link to them.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221170/Shalnor_Legends_2_Trials_of_Thunder

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30760080/b691d34147477103177043bbc35491046580290f.png[/img]

[i]Dev Note: No new content, this patch focuses more on quality of life features and bug-fixes and spelling error fixes.[/i]


[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]	
[*]Wrong font was being used in the inventory for the display of Health and Mana Stones.
[*]Made it so that in Windows mode you can change windows size.
[*]Added “Player Blinking” (when you take damage you become immune for 1.5sec and the player blinks to indicate it, this was added so that the player doesn’t constantly die after taking multiple projectiles.. I have increased the amount of damage you take from some projectiles to balance this but it’s still much better and fairer than before.)
[*]“Mana Steal” from “Blade Upgrades” now restores 4 mana instead of 2 mana.
[*]“Manawoven” from “Bracer Upgrades” now restores 2 mana instead of 1 mana.
[*]Healing Potions will now heal for 25% of your health instead of 50%, this is to encourage the use of other potions and elixirs.
[*]Stamina Potion will now restore 70% of your stamina instead of 50%.
[*]Stoneskin Elixir will now increase damage resistance by 30% instead of 20%.
[*]Stoneskin Elixir will now cost -1 Collisa Petals and +1 Ore Chunk to brew. 
[*]Bladedancers Elixir will now increase sword damage by 30% instead of 20%
[*]Sharpshooters Elixir will now increase bow damage by 30% instead of 20%.
[*]Conjurers Elixir will now lower arrow cost by 30% instead of 20%.
[*]NOTE: All Elixir will now last 90 seconds instead of 60 seconds.
[*]Lock game logic to framerate (only when above 55) ??
[*]Changed Audio Sample-rate from 41000 to 48000 in order to avoid vibration and artifacts in the base sound.
[*]The “Frost” gate in Haunted Crag is lit up and it will now give you a hint! 
[*]Lowered the brightness for the Lore Book pages.
[/list]

[h1]Spelling Errors[/h1]
[list]
[*]More than 20+ spelling errors and grammar errors have been fixed.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed some missing tiles in one of the Scarab caves and a cave in the Ungola Deeps area.
[*]Fixed an issue where cancelling The Keepers dialogue in the Tower, it played the wrong sound.
[*]Fixed an issue where the wrong icon was being shown for Sharpshooters Elixir on Desert merchant’s Shop.
[*]Fixed an issue where The keeper in the Illegarde cave kept respawning and repeating the same hint.
[*]Fixed an issue where going into User Interface while standing next to the house door in Illegarde caused issues. 
[*]Made the “Horrid Spider” challenge slightly easier.
[/list]

[h1]Steam API[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the “Completionist” achievement only synced in the Main Menu.
[/list]


If you find any more Bugs, Glitches, Spelling Errors, Etc. Report them here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/651680/discussions/0/1692659769946800772

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30760080/08c57fdfe9b87fb67ed0bdee43c279ad018393d5.png[/img]


[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added “Heroic Mode”. (You must beat the game in “Normal Mode” to unlock it.) NOTE: due to a bug that has been fixed in this patch, the players who have played the game before the release of patch 1.1.0, have to beat the Final Boss again for the progress to be saved).
[*]Added a number of lore books in the game, these books will explain a few things about the Sacred Lands and more importantly give you an understanding of the bigger world outside of the Sacred Lands.
[/list]      
		
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]	
[*]Fire Arrow tool-tip will no longer tell you that it deals twice damage since it’s damage was changed in previous patch.
[*]The Talking Statue in Dreadmire will better explain and “Show” you where to find the key for Deepmire Hollow.
[*]The Soundtrack for “Sandstone Temple” has been changed. 
[*]When selecting the Sword, Armor or Bracers icon in inventory, their description will now show how many upgrades you have unlocked.
[*]The Keeper will now show up in Shandri Wastes and tell the player how important it is to sleep and SAVE the game.
[*]The Keeper will show up in a cave in Haunted Crag and tell the player about one of the hidden treasure chests.
[*]You can now catch a new fish called “Diamond Crest Gourami” in the fishing pond.
[*]In The cave where the player finds the Bow, the keeper will now show at the entrance to ensure that the player doesn’t miss the conversation with him.
[*]Added some minor performance improvements that nobody will even notice.
[*]Increased drop rate for gold and crafting materials for Normal Mode.
[*]You can now completely skip a dialogue by pressing the “Cancel” button.
[*]Increased base Stamina Regeneration.
[*]Added additional barrels in Tikkie Tower.
[*]Made the Final Boss significantly harder to beat.
[*]The Game Files in Main Menu will now show Difficulty instead of Total Gold.
[*]Removed Social Media Spam from the Pause Menu.
[*]All pre-patch 1.1.0 Players have been returned to Brode's house in Illegarde… For their own safety!
[/list]

[h1]Bugs & Glitches[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a visual issue where in the Sword Upgrade menu the letter “e” in “when” was changing it’s position when switching between “Life Steal” and “Mana Steal” in the item description.
[*]Some pre-patch 1.1.0 players ended up with extra “Mana Stones” or “Life Stones” at the end of the game due to previous bugs. Extra Mana and Life Stones are now removed from the inventory screen.
[*]There was a bug with the “Mana Stone” sold by the Ghost Merchant in Dreadmire, the bug has been fixed but pre-patch 1.1.0 players will have to purchase it again.
[*]Fixed a visual glitch for one of Ghost Merchant's shop display where a "Mana Stone" was pretending to have been purchased.
[*]Fixed a problem where collision was mission for two of the walls in a cave.
[*]There was a problem with the Final Boss, the progression “That you have defeated the boss” wasn’t being saved. Pre-patch 1.1.0 will have to defeat the Final Boss again.
[*]Fixed an audio glitch that sometimes happened when the game launched.
[/list]

[h1]Spelling & Grammar[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a spelling error where Bernard was saying “Trail” instead of “Trial”.
[*]Fixed an issue where “The Keeper” was misspelling the word “Challenge”.
[*]Fixed an issue where “The Keeper” was misspelling the word “Extremely”.
[*]The “exclamation mark” for Sorra when she says: “Oh my” was not properly showing up sometimes. 
[/list]

[h1]Soundtrack DLC[/h1]
[list]
[*]Replaced the old “Sandstone Temple” track with new one.
[*]Changed the background of “Album Cover” so that it looks similar to the background of the soundtrack’s Steam Stores Header.
[/list] 

[h1]Steam API[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem where the “Treasure Hunter” achievement wasn’t working for some players. 
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Casual Reader (Read 2 Lore Books.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Lore Master (Read ALL the Lore Books.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: The Diamond Fish! (Catch a "Diamond Crest Gourami in the fishing pond.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Heroic Gatherer (Gather 10 of each crafting material in Heroic Mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Monster Slayer Heroica! (Vanquish 100 Monsters in Heroic mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Life of a Hero (Find 6 Life Stones while playing the game in Heroic Mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Hero of Mana (Find 6 Mana Stones while playing the game in Heroic Mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Full Metal Huntress! (Find ALL of the collectible items and get all the upgrades while playing the game in Heroic Mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Heroic Boss Fight! (Defeat one of the Dungeon Bosses in Heroic Mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Spirit of Fortune (Find the 3 Golden Figurines and bring them to the Envoy of Goldisa while playing the game in Heroic Mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Spirit of Hope (Find the 3 Sapphire Figurines and bring them to the Envoy of Aurora while playing the game in Heroic Mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Spirit of Determination (Find the 3 Azure Figurines and bring them to the Envoy of Deteri while playing the game in Heroic Mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Spirit of Joy (Find the 3 Emerald Figurines and bring them to the Envoy of Jetri while playing the game in Heroic Mode.)
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: Final Boss Heroica! (Defeat the Final Boss in Heroic Mode) 
[*]NEW ACHIEVEMENT: The Completionist (Get ALL the other Achievements.)
[/list]


If you find any more Bugs, Glitches, Spelling Errors, Etc. Report them here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/651680/discussions/0/1692659769946800772

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes[/h1]	
[list]
[*]The Keeper will show up in two additional places and give the player some extra tips.
[*]The second Dungeon Boss was too easy, made it harder.
[*]The third Dungeon Boss was too hard, made it easier.
[*]Significantly increased base Mana regeneration.
[*]The collision of some traps and explosions was a bit unfair so I have slightly reduced them.
[*]Fixed an issue where the wrong prompt was being shown for one of the portal Tooltips.
[*]Changed the health of some monsters, made some of them stronger and some of them weaker.
[*]Changed base damage of some arrow types, also made it so that some monsters take extra damage from some arrow types and less damage from other arrow types.
[*]Added more Barrels in the Final Dungeon and made some cosmetic changes to the Dungeon's design.
[*]Made some changes to the Twitter prompt in the Pause Menu. 
[*]Added “© 2018 Johnny Ostad” in the Main Menu.
[/list]
	
[h1]Spelling & Grammar[/h1] 
[list]		
[*]Fixed a typo where an NPC was supposed to say “Fun” but instead was saying “Fan”.
[*]Fixed a spelling error where an NPC was saying “Studieng” instead of “Studying”.
[/list]

[h1]Bugs & Glitches[/h1]
[list]
[*]fixed and issue where buying final upgrades from one of the NPCs caused the game to crash.
[*]Fixed an issue where one of the Ghost Merchants was selling the wrong collectible item.
[*]Fixed an issue where one of the Hidden Chests was rewarding the wrong collectible item (You will have to re-open this chest again.)
[*]Fixed an audio Issue where talking to some of the Ghost Merchants and transiting to the shop UI the wrong sound effect was being played.
[/list]

[h1]Steam API[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where using Steam Overlay’s Screenshot function was not working.
[*]ACHIEVEMENT: Resolved an issue where eating Chicken Stew five times would only count towards the achievement “Brode’s Finest” if you eat the stew from the first bag slot, now it works from any bag slot.
[*]ACHIEVEMENT: Fixed an issue with the “Little Spender” and “Big Spender” achievements. (The next time you load a save file these achievements will register automatically and you do not have to redo them.)
[*]ACHIEVEMENT: Fixed an issue with the “Life!” And “Mana!” achievements, they were not working properly for some players. (The next time you load a save file these achievements will register automatically and you do not have to redo them.)
[/list]


If you find any more Bugs, Glitches, Spelling Errors, Etc. Report them here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/651680/discussions/0/1692659769946800772
